decision: f-2 result kind for a failed review
why: the review brief allows a questions handoff; the existing questions branch already checks trust, no-questions and timing, so T5 resumes the review once when answers land

choice: rejected running T5 inside the fresh read of T6
why: it would duplicate comment handling in the retry path

choice: skip a plan whose round is not the job's plan_round
why: T1P rejects any other round as stale-plan; the round check closes both repro C (wrong round) and repro D (tied floored timestamp)
it fixes repro D only, not repro C

choice: one plan_round helper shared by lib/brief/common.py and T6
why: the brief tells the builder its round with this rule, so the two cannot drift
giving plan jobs a structured round field changes plan.py and retry.py job detail, outside this ticket

choice: T6 applies T5's own _asks_questions rule to every questions comment, handled or not
why: T5 records no-questions only after the fresh T6 read; one shared predicate keeps the two from drifting

choice: rejected deferring T6 until T5 handles the comment
why: the body alone decides no-questions, so waiting for T5 adds a deferred state with nothing to wait for

choice: plan_round reads evidence.instructions.plan_attempt before the round=2/2 prefix
why: T5 replaces the instruction with the answer link, but plan_attempt is plan_gap_count + 1 at enqueue, the round T1P accepts; the brief now tells a resumed round-two builder round 2 too

choice: every job's result must come after the comment that queued it, as update jobs and _answered_by already required
why: the answers that resumed a job always follow the question they answer, so that question is excluded even when its timestamps tie the resume

choice: keep outcome == "no-questions" beside the _asks_questions body check
why: T5 rules on the body it read and records that by comment id; an edit afterwards must not override it, while the body check still covers a comment T5 has not handled
